3. **Discriminate between catalyst activation (M6) and ligand-dependent mechanisms (M8)**: High S may indirectly affect ligand availability or activation dynamics.  
This condition avoids extremes (catalyst remains at 0.1 to prevent saturation) while maximizing mechanistic differentiation.
